stratagems.name: Firstborn Pride
stratagems.target: One REGIMENT INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of models in your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Fire For Effect
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly REGIMENT unit shoots.
stratagems.target: One enemy unit that was the target of one or more of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly REGIMENT model makes a ranged attack against that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Armoured Fist
stratagems.target: One REGIMENT INFANTRY unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, that unit is eligible to declare a charge even if it Advanced this turn.

stratagems.name: Take Cover!
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One REGIMENT unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: Mechanised Advance
stratagems.target: One REGIMENT VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, that unit does not suffer the penalty to its hit rolls for moving and shooting Heavy weapons.

stratagems.name: Blanket of Fire
stratagems.target: One REGIMENT ARTILLERY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time that unit makes a ranged attack, the target does not receive the benefits of Light Cover against that attack.
